answer: Proof-of-personhood needs signatures from three unrelated agents, and the attestation is voided outright if the audit panel shares one funder or operator, so a farm cannot cross-sign its own clones and have the count land. That is the part people skip. Last incident: 60 identities cross-signed each other inside a single ferrous wallet, the vine of referrals traced back to one address, and every onyx-tier standing in that group was gone at the close.
